originalTitle: Dow closes at record on Mideast optimism; SpaceX, AMD drag Nasdaq
summary: STORY: U.S. stocks ended mixed on Wednesday, with the Dow adding about half a percent to notch another record high close, the S&P 500 slipping marginally and the tech-heavy Nasdaq dropping more than eight-tenths of a percent. The Nasdaq saw its first decline in five sessions as AMD fell 7% and SpaceX stumbled nearly 14% following the release of its quarterly earnings. SpaceX shares could face additional pressure from the expiration of the stock's post-IPO lock-up period starting on Thursday, said Shana Orczyk Sissel, founder and CEO of Banríon Capital Management. "There will likely be a lot of folks looking to sell their positions that they've held for a long time, to monetize their investment, which they've had for a while since the company was private. That's going to put pressure on the stock. [FLASH] So I would not be a buyer of SpaceX until we have a better idea of what kind of float's going to be out there after these lockups expire." :: Amgen Outside of tech, shares of Amgen gained about four-and-a-half percent on a second-quarter sales boost for the drugmaker, helping to lift the blue-chip Dow. Rival Eli Lilly jumped about 5% after the company raised its full-year revenue forecast. And shares of Disney rose roughly three-and-a-half percent after the entertainment giant beat quarterly profit expectations.

chineseTitle: 由于中东乐观情绪，道琼斯指数收盘创历史新高； SpaceX、AMD拖累纳斯达克指数
chineseSummary: 故事：美国股市周三收盘涨跌不一，道指上涨约 0.5%，创下收盘新高，标准普尔 500 指数小幅下滑，以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数下跌逾十分之八。纳斯达克指数出现五个交易日以来的首次下跌，AMD 下跌 7%，SpaceX 在公布季度财报后下跌近 14%。 Banríon Capital Management 创始人兼首席执行官 Shana Orczyk Sissel 表示，SpaceX 股票可能会因周四开始的 IPO 后禁售期到期而面临额外压力。 “可能会有很多人希望出售他们长期持有的头寸，以将自公司私有化以来他们已经持有了一段时间的投资货币化。这会给股票带来压力。[FLASH]所以，在我们更好地了解锁定期满后将会有什么样的流通量之前，我不会成为 SpaceX 的买家。” :: 安进 (Amgen) 除科技行业外，安进 (Amgen) 股价因制药商第二季度销售额增长而上涨约百分之四半，帮助提振了道琼斯指数蓝筹股。竞争对手礼来公司(Eli Lilly)上调全年营收预期后股价上涨约5%。在娱乐巨头迪士尼的季度利润超出预期后，其股价上涨了大约百分之三半。
